children: Netwealth keeps its bull at Macquarie despite the Australian investment manager's disappointing September-quarter flows. Shares in Netwealth dropped 8% after its quarterly update, a move that one of the investment bank's analysts reckons left its premium relative to the S&P/ASX 200 benchmark index 40% below its five-year average. The analyst tells clients in a note that Netwealth still offers robust EPS growth, strong fundamentals and opportunity tailwinds at an attractive valuation. Macquarie reiterates its outperform rating and raises its target price 0.7% to 27.70 Australian dollars. Shares are up 6.7% at A$16.45. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
